intro: Bring flexibility to your room with Pod Ottoman. Use it as a seat, footrest, or side table, and enjoy a versatile accent that adds comfort, color, and character to everyday living.

features.title: Multi-use design for flexible living
features.text: Works as a pouf, extra seat, or footrest, letting you switch functions effortlessly and making your room adapt to daily needs.

features.title: Soft cushioned comfort you notice
features.text: Foam padding keeps it plush yet supportive, so resting your feet or sitting for short chats always feels cozy and pleasant.

features.title: Compact and lightweight to move
features.text: Shifts easily around your home, so you can change layouts, add quick seating, or bring it closer when you need extra function.

features.title: Durable fabric built for daily life
features.text: Upholstery stays soft yet strong through frequent use, making it a practical piece you can rely on every day.

features.title: Forest green that energizes décor
features.text: The bold green upholstery adds a vibrant lift to your room, blending with woods and neutrals for a lively, modern touch.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
